about.title: About MAJORMATCH AI
about.subtitle: AI-powered academic guidance for every student.
about.mission_text: MAJORMATCH AI was built to help students discover the university major that truly fits them — using the power of artificial intelligence, personalized assessments, and real academic data. We believe every student deserves clarity about their future.
about.how_text: You answer a series of carefully designed questions about your interests, skills, and goals. Our Gemini AI engine then analyzes your responses and matches you with the most suitable academic majors, complete with study plans and career paths.
about.tech_text: Built with React, Node.js, SQLite, and powered by Google Gemini AI. The system supports 4 languages and delivers personalized recommendations in seconds.
about.team_text: MAJORMATCH AI is a freelance project focused on making academic guidance accessible, smart, and free for all students worldwide.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about MAJORMATCH AI.
faq.q1: Is MAJORMATCH AI free to use?
faq.a1: Yes, MAJORMATCH AI is completely free. Create an account and start your assessment today.
faq.q2: How accurate are the major recommendations?
faq.a2: Our AI analyzes your interests, skills, and goals with high accuracy. The more honestly you answer, the better your match will be.
faq.a3: Absolutely. You can take the assessment multiple times. Each attempt is saved in your history so you can track changes over time.
faq.q4: What languages does the platform support?
faq.a4: MAJORMATCH AI supports English, Arabic, Spanish, and French. You can switch languages at any time.
faq.q5: How does the AI chat work?
faq.a5: After receiving your recommendation, you can chat with our Gemini AI assistant to ask follow-up questions about your major, study plan, or career paths.
faq.a6: Yes. Your data is stored securely and is never shared with third parties. We use JWT authentication and encrypted passwords.
